item.title: Lawmakers propose liquor at grocery stores and cannabis beverages at liquor stores
item.description: Democratic lawmakers in New York have introduced bills that would allow supermarkets and local bodegas to sell hard alcohol and wine, and liquor stores to sell low-potency weed beverages, with the goal of modernizing the state's alcohol laws and boosting vineyards, agricultural businesses, and the craft spirits industry.

item.title: Honoring Black History: First in Their Fields
item.description: Sharon Owens, Lillie Fields, and Dr. Warren Hilton are three Central New Yorkers who have made history as the first Black Mayor of Syracuse, the first Black principal in the Liverpool Central School District, and the first Black president of Onondaga Community College, respectively.
